name: spellkave_define_behavior
label: Define Behavior (verb PoC)
description: PoC (#1968): author ONE capability→affordance→action→outcome→consequence→frame_write chain (+ an optional cost debit) in a single call, granted to `grant_to`. Drives @spellkave/world-author's `clusterRows` — the SAME behavior-cluster builder the SRD content drivers use (FIX③, #1968 de-fork) — bundle-namespaced via `BehaviorConfig.idNamespace`. `primitive` fields are CLOSED PoC enums — only the real kernel shapes the worked fireball/find_familiar/core-mark examples need are wired; anything else fails loudly naming the PoC boundary. #1968 US9 VERB EXPANSION: `effect.write.primitive` now also accepts 'Spawn' (Brief 26 EffectPrimitive::Spawn — instantiate an entity_def at the actor's own node) and 'Inscribe' (the raw FrameWriteOp::Inscribe trace idiom — a durable typed footprint, no resource delta); both require `offered_when.target: 'self'|'place'` (a target concept beyond 'hit others in a radius') and never combine with `effect.shape`/`effect.per_target_gate`. `target: 'self'` needs a `cost` (else this tool errors BEFORE validation with a hint, MF-VAL-263); `target: 'place'` needs none (self_eligible stays false, so the self-budget check never engages). `effect.write.resource` (ModifyResource) / `effect.write.entity_def` (Spawn) must already be authored (this PoC never auto-creates write-target resources/blueprints — use spellkave_define_resource / spellkave_define_entity_type first); `cost.pool`, if new, IS auto-created with generic bounds. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the whole generated cluster (capability/ outcome/affordance/action/consequence/frame-write/live-wiring rows) rather than duplicating it.

bundle.description: bundle_id stamped on every generated row. Omit to fall back to `context.defaultBundle` (#1968 smart default).

id.description: Behavior key stem — derives capability_id '<bundle>/spell/<id>' and action_id '<bundle>/cast_<id>' (+ its outcome/affordance/consequence siblings), unless overridden by `capability_id`.

capability_id.description: #1968 verb-UX round 2: override the derived '<bundle>/spell/<id>' capability_id — e.g. for a CATALOG spell whose entity_definitions.entity_def_id already exists under a different id shape (mirrors compose.ts's ActorBehavior.capabilityId — for a catalog spell this MUST equal the catalog entity_def_id so the capability IS the catalog identity, #835). `action_id` is never touched by this — only the capability's own id changes.

action_prefix.description: #1968 srd-migration round: override the derived action id's prefix — the full action id is '<bundle>/<action_prefix><id>' (default 'cast_', e.g. id='fireball' -> '<bundle>/cast_fireball'). Pass '' to derive a BARE '<bundle>/<id>' action id (e.g. the Hex/Bless/Bardic-Inspiration condition-modified-roll family's WRITER/CONSUMER pair, whose action ids are '<bundle>/<key>', not '<bundle>/cast_<key>') — mirrors compose.ts's BehaviorConfig.actionPrefix verbatim; outcome/affordance/success ids all derive from the SAME action id, so this affects all four.

emit_capability.description: #1968 srd-migration round: whether this call authors a capability_definitions row for `capability_id`/the derived id. Default true. Pass false when the capability ALREADY exists (authored by ANOTHER call/fragment, e.g. a feat grant that already created it) and this call should REUSE it — `required_capability`/`actor_capabilities`/the niche all still key on `capability_id` (which then MUST be set — omitting it AND setting false derives an id no prior call could have authored), but no duplicate capability_definitions row is emitted (mirrors compose.ts's ActorBehavior.emitCapability, a required field there, made an optional smart default here since every prior verb caller wanted true).

display_name.description: #1968 verb-UX round 2: overrides the derived 'Cast <TitleCase id>' display name stamped onto every generated row that carries one (capability/action/affordance/outcome). Omit for the smart default — naive per-word title-casing mangles a multi-word id containing a preposition (e.g. 'circle_of_death' -> 'Cast Circle Of Death' instead of 'Cast Circle of Death').

description.description: Sets the generated capability_definitions row's own `description` column (#1968) — the capability is this behavior's natural authoring-identity anchor, so that is where the description lands (NOT the affordance/action/outcome/consequence/resource rows this verb also generates).

observation.description: #1968 B-9: authored PLAYER-facing prose for what a player perceives on a successful manipulate or sensing outcome — distinct from `description` above, which stays operator-only on capability_definitions. Sets the generated outcome_templates row's own `description` column (its actual authoring/read home — see outcome_template.rs's doc comment for why that table, not action_definitions/consequence_templates). May reference ONLY the frozen placeholders `{target_name}`, `{actor_name}`, `{place_name}` (resolved from data the player already sees, never a raw id) — a state-dereferencing value (HP, a resource, a condition) belongs in the DSL outcome expression, not here, and an unknown placeholder or a description over 500 chars is rejected at validation. Omit for the existing default: the tool result carries an honest `observation: null` + `observation_gap`, byte-identical to today.

tags.description: #1968 verb-UX round 2: the FULL capability_definition_tag AND action_definition_tag row set — when set, REPLACES the single `action_class` tag as the authoritative list for BOTH satellites (include `action_class`'s own value in `tags` too, if wanted — it is not auto-prepended). Omit for the legacy default: `action_class` alone becomes the one action tag, no capability tags — `action_class` itself is REQUIRED either way (no default of its own, #1968 finding A1): this param only controls what ELSE joins it, never whether it is needed.

communication_speech_act_id.description: #1968 verb-UX round 4 (SPEECH-ACT lens, Searle) — when set, the generated action's outcome_templates row carries this `communication_speech_act_id`, so the affordance SURFACES as a communication speech act while r_manipulate still EXECUTES the gated consequence normally via `manipulation_action_id` (mirrors compose.ts's ActorBehavior.communicationSpeechActId — the Persuasion 'directive' worked example). Omit for the legacy default: no speech-act framing.

grant_to.description: entity_key of the caster (already placed via spellkave_place_actor) granted the capability — or an ARRAY of entity_keys to grant the SAME capability to several actors in one call (#1968 finding B4: 'author once, grant twice' — e.g. two mechanically-identical monsters sharing one scimitar). The capability/action/affordance/outcome/consequence cluster is authored exactly ONCE regardless (keyed off the FIRST entry, which also becomes `defaultCaster` for any `[[actors]]`/entities the shape itself emits, e.g. Spawn's `def_instance`) — every entry gets its OWN `actor_capabilities` grant + `spatial_niche_attachments` row (attached to ITS OWN node, resolved independently per entity_key, exactly like the single-actor case). Each caster needs a nonblank place_node_id, resolved from the workspace before the active target. If a live AUTHOR cannot read the caster's placement, the call fails before writing scratch; supply its known current actor_spatial_locations workspace row. #1968 workspace idempotency: re-authoring the SAME bundle+id REPLACES the WHOLE grant set — an entity_key dropped from the array on a later call has its grant and attachment rows cleared, not left behind (mirrors every other satellite this verb folds).

reach.description: Closed PoC enum — only 'same_node' is wired (its own range_m default, see `range_m`).

range_m.description: Affordance range_m (metres, ADR-0053 metric embedding) — author via the ft() feet→metric helper (e.g. ft(5) for standard 5-ft melee reach), never a raw metre literal. Omit for the default range_m=0 (touch/same-node only).

target.description: #1968 US9 — a target concept beyond 'ForEachActorInRadius hits others in a radius'. Omit for the legacy default (`effect.write.primitive` must be 'ModifyResource', wrapped in `effect.shape`'s ForEachActorInRadius — unaffected by this param). 'self': the acting actor targets ITSELF (action_definitions.self_eligible=true, mirrors srd/cast_find_familiar's self_eligible=true) — MF-VAL-263 then requires SOME ModifyResource in the on_success chain; `effect.write.primitive: 'ModifyResource'` satisfies it on its own, but 'Spawn'/'Inscribe' need an explicit `cost` (else this tool errors BEFORE validation with a hint). 'place': the write lands at the actor's OWN place_node with NO target-actor selection and NO self-targeting at all (self_eligible stays false — MF-VAL-263 never engages, so no `cost` pool is required or accepted); only 'Spawn'/'Inscribe' support 'place' (no fixture idiom modifies a resource with neither an actor nor a self target).

action_class.description: action_definition_tag applied to the generated action (e.g. 'spell'). REQUIRED — has no default (#1968 finding A1): omitting it throws a named-param error rather than silently authoring a corrupt row. Overridden (not supplemented) by `tags` when that param is set.

pool.description: resource_definition_id debited on cast (e.g. a spell-slot pool).

amount.description: How much to debit per cast.

primitive.description: Closed PoC enum — only 'ForEachActorInRadius' is wired.

id.description: Closed PoC enum: 'core/area/node_ball' (topological — radius = ball_radius graph-edge hops, 0 = same node) or 'core/area/sphere' (metric — radius = radius_m). Other area shapes need direct authoring.

radius.description: node_ball: integer edge-hop radius. sphere: metric radius_m.

per_target_gate.description: Authored Bool DSL expression gating the write, e.g. 'd20 < 13' (a failed save) or 'd20 >= 13' (a hit). Omit for an ungated write. aoe (effect.shape set): gates the body PER SELECTED ACTOR. single-target (effect.shape omitted): gates the AFFORDANCE itself (a miss/failed-check skips the whole consequence — the attack-roll seam). ModifyResource only — MUST be omitted for 'Spawn'/'Inscribe'.

primitive.description: Closed PoC enum — the REAL kernel primitive names (#1968 US9/srd-migration round, never invented; verified against world-fixtures/srd/base/summon.toml + world-fixtures/core/base/affordances.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/hold-monster.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/lesser-restoration.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/darkness.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/acid-arrow.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/moonbeam.toml + world-fixtures/srd/base/death-saves.toml): 'ModifyResource' (a resource/state delta — the original fireball-wired primitive), 'Spawn' (Brief 26 EffectPrimitive::Spawn — instantiate an entity_def at the actor's own node, the find_familiar shape; requires `offered_when.target`), 'Inscribe' (the raw FrameWriteOp::Inscribe trace idiom core/mark/core/pickup/core/drop use — a durable typed footprint, NO ModifyResource delta and NO companion definition row; requires `offered_when.target`), 'ApplyStatus' (lands a condition on the single TargetActor — the B9 Hold-Person/Hold-Monster/Bless-family shape; single-target only, no `offered_when.target`), 'RemoveCondition' (the INVERSE — deletes a matching target_condition row, the Lesser-Restoration cleanse shape; single-target only, no `offered_when.target`), 'EnvState' (#1968 verb-UX round 4 — the Darkness/Silence/Fog AMBIENT-EFFECT shape, compose.ts's 'env-state': the cast's ONLY write is an Inscribe{kind:'spatial_environment_state'} bool marker on the caster's cell (or the target cell — see `env_state_center`); this call auto-creates the backing spatial_state_definitions row, mirroring `cost.pool`'s auto-create; a SEPARATELY-authored consumer affordance reads target.state(env_state_id); single-target only, no `offered_when.target`), 'OutcomeGraph' (#1968 verb-UX round 4 — the branch-on-outcome shape, compose.ts's 'outcome-graph': the action's outcome invokes a graph whose `branches` (see that field) each carry their OWN ModifyResource(TargetActor, srd/hp, ...) consequence, selected by the first true edge guard in array order — unlike a gated single-target write, EVERY branch can apply an effect (a Melf's Acid Arrow miss still deals half damage); single-target only, no `offered_when.target`), 'ScheduledZone' (#1968 verb-UX round 5 — the TRUE LINGERING hazard shape, compose.ts's 'scheduled-zone' (ADR-0054): the cast's ONLY direct write is the SAME Inscribe{kind:'spatial_environment_state'} marker EnvState uses (auto-creates the backing spatial_state_definitions row, `zone_state_id`/`zone_intensity`/ `zone_visibility`/`zone_center` — see those fields); it ALSO schedules a subject-bound ScheduleAutonomyJob (`schedule` — repeats/frequency/liveness/source) that re-fires a SEPARATE, self-contained pulse consequence each round — a node-local ForEachActorInRadius (fixed radius, ball_radius 0) wrapping `effect.write.pulse`, which REUSES this same closed enum's two autonomy-clock-eligible bodies ('ModifyResource' damage/heal via `pulse.delta`, or 'ApplyStatus' condition via `pulse.condition`) rather than inventing a third write vocabulary; `effect.per_target_gate` (if set) gates the PULSE body per occupant (the save-negate seam — Stinking Cloud), not the affordance; single-target-only, no `offered_when.target`), 'Clock' (#1968 finding C2 — the SELF-TARGETED multi-ordinal clock shape, compose.ts's 'clock' (the death-saves death-and-dying pattern): unlike every OTHER primitive above (each writes a TargetActor or a radius-selected OTHER actor), a clock's every write targets the ACTING subject alone. `tallies` (see that field) — N bare ModifyResource(actor='Actor', ...) ordinals, authored first, array order = ordinal order — followed by `thresholds` (see that field) — M ForEachActorInRadius(node_ball, ball_radius 0) ordinals wrapping an ApplyStatus/RemoveCondition on 'Actor', reading the tallies' just-written state; requires `offered_when.target: 'self'` (a clock is inherently self-only — there is no 'hit others' reading of it) and needs no separate `cost` (the tallies themselves satisfy MF-VAL-263's on_success ModifyResource requirement); single-target-topology-only, no `effect.shape`/`effect.per_target_gate` (each threshold carries its OWN `when` instead of one shared per-target gate — `effect.per_target_gate`, if set, becomes the AFFORDANCE's own eligibility gate instead, e.g. "actor.status('dying') == true && ...", the same seam single-target's attack-roll gate reuses)). 'Spawn'/'Inscribe' are NOT FrameWriteOp arms nestable inside a ForEachActorInRadius body — they never combine with `effect.shape`/`effect.per_target_gate` (PoC boundary: only 'ModifyResource' selects actors in a radius). 'ApplyStatus'/'RemoveCondition'/'EnvState'/'OutcomeGraph'/'ScheduledZone'/'Clock' are single-target-only too (PoC boundary: no aoe condition/env-state/outcome-graph/scheduled-zone-CAST/clock pulse is wired — the scheduled-zone shape's OWN pulse is always the fixed node_ball-0 radius, never `effect.shape`) — they never combine with `effect.shape` either ('ScheduledZone' reuses `effect.per_target_gate` for its pulse's per-occupant gate instead, 'Clock' reuses it for the affordance's eligibility gate instead, see above).

resource.description: ModifyResource only: must already resolve to an authored resource_definitions row (workspace, live, or the active target) — this PoC does not auto-create write-target resources (only `cost.pool` auto-creates, see the tool description). aoe (effect.shape set): the resource every selected actor's body write targets. single-target (effect.shape omitted, #1968 verb-UX round 2): the resource the ONE TargetActor write targets — defaults to 'srd/hp'-shaped combat use but any already-authored resource/state works (e.g. a non-HP disposition state).

delta.description: ModifyResource only: authored Int DSL expression evaluated per target, e.g. '-d6'. aoe: applied to every selected actor. single-target: applied once, to the ONE TargetActor. Ignored (may be omitted) when `attacks` is set.

This sub-attack's authored Int DSL expression, self-gating its OWN attack roll (e.g. 'cond(d20 >= 11, 0 - (1d8 + 5), 0)') — a miss on THIS roll must resolve to 0, not skip the whole action (unlike the single-attack affordance-gated shape).

label.description: Human tag for this sub-attack (e.g. 'Rend'), report-only.

attacks.description: One entry per sub-attack (2+ for an SRD Multiattack, but generalises to any N) — see this field's own top-level description for the full shape.

entity_def.description: Spawn only: the entity_definitions catalog id to instantiate at the actor's own node (e.g. 'srd/monster/cat', mirroring srd/cast_find_familiar) — must already resolve (workspace or live); this PoC does not auto-create the blueprint.

trace_kind.description: Inscribe only: the trace's `kind` discriminant (e.g. 'puddle_mark') — an arbitrary authored string; unlike `resource`, this is NEVER ref-checked against a definitions row (core/mark's own 'scrape_marks' has none either — FrameWriteOp::Inscribe's own doc: 'a durable typed footprint without a resource delta').

content.description: Inscribe only: the trace's `payload_json` content — a JSON-encodable string describing the mark (e.g. '{"action":"relieve"}').

condition.description: ApplyStatus/RemoveCondition only: the condition_definitions condition_definition_id landed on (ApplyStatus) or deleted from (RemoveCondition) the single TargetActor — must already resolve (workspace, live, or the active target); this PoC does not auto-create the condition (use spellkave_define_condition first).

remove_source.description: RemoveCondition only: an exact source key to match (FrameWriteOp::RemoveCondition's `source_match: Exact`). Omit for the default 'Any' — source-agnostic removal (matches ANY target_condition row for `condition`, regardless of what applied it).

env_state_id.description: EnvState only: the spatial_state_definitions id this write flips (e.g. 'srd/darkness') — auto-created by this call as a BOOL state def with writer_policy 'world_interaction' (so the apply path may write it at cast time) and a long freshness, mirroring `cost.pool`'s auto-create; this PoC never requires it pre-authored. A separately-authored consumer affordance reads target.state(env_state_id) — this call does not author the consumer.

env_state_value.description: EnvState only: the bool value the marker Inscribe writes. Default true ('on').

env_state_center.description: EnvState only: 'actor' (default) writes the CASTER'S OWN cell (ActorSpatialRef — follows the caster, a Darkness-shaped ambient cast). 'target' anchors on the cast's TARGET cell (TargetSpatialRef) instead.

node.description: This branch's outcome_graph node id (e.g. 'hit'/'miss'; also the outcome/consequence id stem).

guard.description: This branch's edge guard predicate, evaluated root→node in array order — the FIRST true guard wins (e.g. 'd20 >= 13'); the LAST branch should carry a '1 == 1' fallthrough so some branch always selects.

delta.description: This branch's authored Int DSL expression — the ModifyResource delta its terminal node's consequence applies when selected (e.g. '0 - 4d4'), written against `subject`'s `resource`.

label.description: Human tag for this branch, report-only.

subject.description: This branch's own write subject — a kernel symbolic actor ref: 'TargetActor' (default, the damage-against-target shape every prior branch authored) or 'Actor' (the CASTER, e.g. a defeat-consequence XP credit back to the attacker — playable-fighter-l1-20 D-1). Omit to keep today's byte-identical shape.

resource.description: This branch's own write resource — must already resolve to an authored resource_definitions row, same rule as the top-level `resource` field. Defaults to 'srd/hp'. Omit to keep today's byte-identical shape.

branches.description: OutcomeGraph only: one entry per branch arm (2+ — see this field's own top-level description). Required, and must be non-empty, when effect.write.primitive is 'OutcomeGraph'.

zone_state_id.description: ScheduledZone only: the spatial_state_definitions id the marker Inscribe (and every pulse) reads/writes (e.g. 'srd/hazard/cloudkill') — auto-created by this call as an INT state def with writer_policy 'world_interaction' and a long freshness, mirroring EnvState's `env_state_id` auto-create (and `cost.pool`'s). Required when effect.write.primitive is 'ScheduledZone'.

zone_intensity.description: ScheduledZone only: the documentary int value the marker Inscribe stamps (e.g. the spell's damage magnitude — Cloudkill's 5d8 stamps 5). Default 0. Never read by the pulse itself (the pulse's own damage/condition comes from `pulse.delta`/`pulse.condition`) — purely an observable marker value.

zone_visibility.description: ScheduledZone only: the marker Inscribe's visibility class. Default 'Public'.

zone_center.description: ScheduledZone only: 'actor' (default) anchors the marker AND every pulse on the CASTER'S CURRENT cell each fire (ActorSpatialRef — a mobile aura that follows the caster). 'target' anchors on the cast's TARGET cell instead (TargetSpatialRef — the captured anchor_place_node_id stays FIXED even if the caster moves; the faithful 'dropped at range' hazard every shipped scheduled-zone spell today uses — Cloudkill/Moonbeam/Stinking Cloud/the scheduled-damage-zone batch). Mirrors EnvState's `env_state_center` — same two-value anchor concept, kept as its own field because it is scoped to a different write primitive.

repeats.description: How many rounds the pulse re-fires — bounds the duration (a subject-bound actor-reaching autonomy job MUST be bounded, server fence + MF-VAL-249). Default 10 (SRD's common 'concentration up to 1 minute' → 10 one-tick rounds).

frequency_ms.description: Fiction-millisecond period between pulses. Default 6000 (fires every round).

requires_subject_alive.description: Whether the zone dissipates if the caster's entity is removed. Default false (the zone lingers its full duration regardless — the SRD Cloudkill/Moonbeam behaviour). Set true for a concentration-style hazard that ends with its caster.

source.description: The cancel-by-source/provenance key stamped on the runtime autonomy_job — author with the {Actor}/{ResponsibleSubject}/{tick} placeholders (ADR-0055 D-3), e.g. '<bundle>/<id>/{Actor}/{tick}', so the scheduler interpolates a PER-CAST-UNIQUE job_id at cast time (two concurrent casts never collide on the autonomy_job PK). Omit for the compose.ts legacy default ('srd/<id>', UNqualified by `bundle` — pass this explicitly for any non-'srd' bundle).

schedule.description: ScheduledZone only: the ADR-0054 autonomy-pulse cadence + provenance. Every field optional — omit the whole object for compose.ts's defaults (repeats 10, frequency_ms 6000, requires_subject_alive false, source 'srd/<id>').

primitive.description: The scheduled pulse's OWN per-round frame_write body (wrapped in a fixed node-local ForEachActorInRadius, ball_radius 0, by clusterRows — never `effect.shape`) — REUSES this tool's two autonomy-clock-eligible write shapes rather than a new vocabulary: 'ModifyResource' (a damage/heal delta on 'srd/hp', the Cloudkill/Moonbeam/scheduled-damage-zone-batch shape) or 'ApplyStatus' (lands a condition on each occupant, the Stinking Cloud save-or-condition shape — #958 admits ApplyStatus to the subject-bound autonomy fence).

delta.description: pulse.primitive 'ModifyResource' only: the authored Int DSL expression applied to EVERY occupant's srd/hp each pulse (e.g. 'cond(d20 >= 13, 0 - (5d8 / 2), 0 - 5d8)' for save-for-half — fold the save into the delta the same way single-target/aoe do). Required when pulse.primitive is 'ModifyResource'.

condition.description: pulse.primitive 'ApplyStatus' only: the condition_definitions id landed on every occupant whose `effect.per_target_gate` passes (e.g. 'srd/poisoned') — must already resolve (workspace, live, or the active target); this PoC does not auto-create it (use spellkave_define_condition first). Required when pulse.primitive is 'ApplyStatus'.

pulse.description: ScheduledZone only: the pulse's own write. Required when effect.write.primitive is 'ScheduledZone' — a zone with no pulse body would schedule a job that fires nothing.

resource.description: Clock only: the resource_definitions id this tally ordinal's bare ModifyResource(actor='Actor', ...) reads/writes — must already resolve (workspace, live, or the active target); this PoC does not auto-create tally resources (use spellkave_define_resource first, same posture as effect.write.resource).

predicate.description: Clock only: an authored Bool DSL expression — when set, this ordinal's delta_source becomes 'cond(<predicate>, <delta ?? "1">, 0)', the increment-on-condition idiom every tally-split ordinal needs (e.g. "actor.stat('death_save_last_roll') >= 10" to tally a success). Omit for a raw (non-conditional) `delta` expression instead — the scratch-cell-capture idiom a clock's FIRST ordinal often needs (e.g. "d20 - actor.stat('death_save_last_roll')", a set-via-delta that lands exactly on a fresh roll). Exactly one of `predicate`/`delta` must convey the real expression: set `predicate` alone for a plain +1-on-condition tally, `delta` alone for a raw capture, or both when the increment amount is not 1.

delta.description: Clock only: with `predicate` set, the increment amount (default '1') — the expression becomes 'cond(<predicate>, <delta>, 0)'. With `predicate` OMITTED, this is the WHOLE raw delta_source expression verbatim (the scratch-cell-capture idiom — see `predicate`'s own doc). Required when `predicate` is omitted.

tallies.description: Clock only: one entry per self-targeted tally ordinal, authored FIRST (array order = ordinal order, before every `thresholds` entry) — see this field's own top-level description. Required, non-empty, when effect.write.primitive is 'Clock'.

when.description: Clock only: this threshold ordinal's own ForEachActorInRadius(node_ball, ball_radius 0) predicate_source, evaluated against the POST-tally state (this ordinal runs after every `tallies` entry) — e.g. "actor.stat('death_save_failures') >= 3", or an OR-branched short-circuit like a nat-20 immediate-stabilize check. A bare ApplyStatus/RemoveCondition carries no delta/predicate of its own to fold a `cond(...)` into, so this wrapper's own predicate_source is the only way to gate one — safe here specifically because every `tallies` ordinal already wrote 'Actor' alone (never a co-located bystander).

apply_status.description: Clock only: the condition_definitions id this threshold lands on 'Actor' when `when` is true — must already resolve (workspace, live, or the active target); this PoC does not auto-create it (use spellkave_define_condition first). Exactly one of `apply_status`/`remove_condition` must be set per threshold entry.

remove_condition.description: Clock only: the condition_definitions id this threshold REMOVES from 'Actor' when `when` is true (the inverse of `apply_status`) — must already resolve. Exactly one of `apply_status`/`remove_condition` must be set per threshold entry.

remove_condition_source.description: Clock + `remove_condition` only: an exact source key to match (RemoveCondition's `source_match: Exact`). Omit for the default 'Any' — source-agnostic removal.

thresholds.description: Clock only: one entry per self-targeted threshold ordinal, authored AFTER every `tallies` entry (array order = ordinal order) — see this field's own top-level description. Required, non-empty, when effect.write.primitive is 'Clock'.

bind_to_definition.description: An already-authored entity_definitions catalog id (workspace, live, or the active target — same 3-way resolution as the placement tools' `entity_def`) that inherits this call's capability at instance birth via entity_definition_initial_capability. This PoC does not auto-create the definition (use spellkave_define_entity_type first).

entity_key.description: The proof instance's fully-qualified entity_key, e.g. 'srd/actor/polar-bear-def'.

name.description: entities.name / actors.name for the proof instance.

node.description: An already-authored place_node id the proof instance is placed at. Omit to default to the resolved caster node (`grant_to`'s own node) — the niche this behavior's capability attaches is already anchored there.
